data.title: 雷电将军 · 团子甜点与紫电私语
data.description: 午后温暖的金色阳光洒进鸣神私室，影斜坐在铺着丝绒软垫的窗台边。修身的高领黑色毛衣勾勒出曼妙起伏的曲线，一腿微屈自然支起，一手轻持三彩团子送到唇边，紫眸微弯带着难得的孩子气好奇。几缕细小的紫色电弧随呼吸在指尖与茶点盒旁跳跃，窗外稻妻城的微风卷起她垂落的发丝。
data.location: 稻妻天守阁鸣神私室窗边
data.action: 斜坐于窗台软垫，一腿微屈，一手轻举三彩团子欲尝，目光专注而带一丝好奇看向观众
data.lighting: 午后金色窗光与微弱紫色电弧
data.camera: from front, facing viewer, three-quarter cowboy shot, eye level
data.mood: 神明探索人间甜味的反差温情
data.promptProse: Ei relaxes on the window seat facing the viewer, wearing a black open-side virgin killer sweater that reveals her delicate collarbone, bare shoulders, and alluring sideboob; afternoon sunlight illuminates her gentle gaze and the sweet dango held gracefully in her hand as purple sparks dance softly.
data.animaCaption: Facing the viewer on the window seat, her black virgin killer sweater reveals her sideboob, collarbone, and bare thighs while holding dango.
